```{r}
# Get the MARFIS data and clean it

#source("C:/Users/graylo/Documents/git/ALOSA.functions/other_functions/pull_marfis_data.R")

source("~/git/ALOSA.functions/functions/sourcery.R")

sourcery()

load("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/29OCT2026 MARFIS PULL.Rdata")
#fix to add in licence 120746. has been corrected as of Nov 04 2026 in MASTER RIVERNAME DATABASE
catch$COUNTY[catch$LICENCE_ID==120746 & catch$YEAR %in% c(2014,2025)]<-"VICTORIA COUNTY"
source("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/marfis_error_cleaner.R")
df <- marfis_error_cleaner(
  catch,
  convert_to_kgs = TRUE,
  tidy_data = TRUE,
  correct_eel_pot = TRUE,
  unknown_rivers_are_na = TRUE,
  unknown_gear_are_na = TRUE
  )

```

```{r}
dfcb<-df[df$COUNTY %in% c("RICHMOND COUNTY", "VICTORIA COUNTY", "CAPE BRETON COUNTY"),]
dfcbsum<-dfcb[c(1,2,4)]
dfcbsum<-dfcbsum[!duplicated(dfcbsum),]
table(dfcbsum$RIVERNAME_CLEANED,dfcbsum$YEAR)

dfcb25<-dfcb[dfcb$YEAR>=2025,]

cbtotlandings<-aggregate(dfcb25$FV_WEIGHT,
                         by=list(LICENCE_ID=dfcb25$LICENCE_ID,YEAR=dfcb25$YEAR,RIVERNAME_CLEANED=dfcb25$RIVERNAME_CLEANED),
                         FUN=sum)
names(cbtotlandings)[4]<-"LANDINGS (KG)"
# write.csv(cbtotlandings,file="R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/Assessment Results/Advisory Meetings/2026/CB/CB24Summary.csv",row.names=F)
```

```{r DNFs}
# Get the licence data provided by RM
licences <- readxl::read_excel("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/MARFISSCI/Gaspereau Licences Area Project.xlsx")

# We can use this to grab data for what licences are not reporting
licences |> 
  select(
    LICENCE_ID = `Licence Id`,
    LICENCE_TYPE = `Licence Type Description (English)`,
    COUNTY = `County Name 1`,
    PROVINCE = `Province Abbrev (English)`,
    GEAR_DESCRIPTION = `Gear Description (English)`,
    RIVERNAME = `RIVER CONFIRMED`
    ) |> 
  filter(COUNTY %in% c("RICHMOND", "VICTORIA", "CAPE BRETON")) |> 
  distinct(LICENCE_ID, COUNTY) |> 
  arrange(LICENCE_ID) -> cb_licences

dnfcb<-didnotfish[didnotfish$LICENCE_ID %in% cb_licences$LICENCE_ID,]
dnfcb25<-dnfcb[dnfcb$YEAR==2025,]

table(dnfcb$YEAR,dnfcb$NIL_REPORT_FLAG)



rep.card.CB<-rep.card[rep.card$LICENCE_ID %in% cb_licences$LICENCE_ID,]
```

```{r}

cb_counties <- c("CAPE BRETON COUNTY", "RICHMOND COUNTY", "VICTORIA COUNTY")

df |> 
  filter(PROVINCE == "NS" & COUNTY %in% cb_counties & YEAR<=2026) |> 
  group_by(YEAR, COUNTY) |> 
  summarise(TOTAL = sum(FV_WEIGHT), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(YEAR = as.factor(YEAR)) |> 
  mutate(
    COUNTY = str_remove(COUNTY, " COUNTY"),
    COUNTY = str_to_title(COUNTY)
  ) |> 
  #mutate(COUNTY = fct_reorder(COUNTY, TOTAL, .fun = sum)) |> 
  mutate(COUNTY = factor(COUNTY, levels = c("Victoria", "Richmond", "Cape Breton"))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(YEAR, TOTAL, fill = COUNTY)) +
  geom_col(colour = "grey10", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    n.breaks = 10,
    labels = scales::comma
    ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Reported landings for Cape Breton (2008 - 2026)", x = "", y = "Landings (kg)", fill = "County") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      # legend.position = "top",
      # legend.justification = "left",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
      # plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
    ) -> landings_CB

landings_CB

ggsave("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/Assessment Results/Advisory Meetings/2026/CB/landings_CB.png", plot = landings_CB, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)


```

```{r}
df |>
  filter(PROVINCE == "NS" & COUNTY %in% c(cb_counties)) |> 
  group_by(YEAR, COUNTY) |> 
  summarise(unique_licences = n_distinct(LICENCE_ID), .groups = "drop") -> cb_lics

cb_lics
```

```{r}
cb_lics |> 
  #complete(COUNTY, YEAR) |> 
  mutate(
    YEAR = as.factor(YEAR),
    COUNTY = str_remove(COUNTY, " COUNTY"),
    COUNTY = str_to_title(COUNTY),
    COUNTY = factor(COUNTY, levels = c("Victoria", "Richmond", "Cape Breton"))
    # COUNTY = fct_reorder(COUNTY, unique_licences, .desc = FALSE)
    ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(YEAR, unique_licences, fill = COUNTY)) +
  geom_col(colour = "grey20", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = 1) +
  labs(title = "Alewife licences in Cape Breton by county (2008 - 2026)", x = "", y = "Licences", fill = "County") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      #axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      # legend.position = "top",
      # legend.justification = "left",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
      # plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 1, hjust=0, label = "INTERNAL ONLY", col = "red", 
             fontface = "bold", alpha = 0.2, angle=35, size = 15)

ggsave("R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/Assessment Results/Advisory Meetings/2026/CB/lics_CB.png", plot = last_plot(), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
df |>
  filter(PROVINCE == "NS" & COUNTY %in% c(cb_counties)) |> 
  group_by(YEAR) |> 
  summarise(unique_licences = n_distinct(LICENCE_ID), .groups = "drop") -> cb_lics2
#I want to add in DNF licences to make a stacked barchart
#use the dnfcb from above chunk
dnfcb |>
  filter(NIL_REPORT_FLAG == "Y") |> 
  group_by(YEAR) |> 
  summarise(unique_licences = n_distinct(LICENCE_ID), .groups = "drop") -> cb_lics_dnf2
dnfcb$YEAR<-as.numeric(dnfcb$YEAR)
cb_lics2$REPORT<-"CATCH"
cb_lics_dnf2$REPORT<-"DNF"

cb_lics2_merged<-rbind(cb_lics2,cb_lics_dnf2)
cb_lics2_merged$REPORT<-as.factor(cb_lics2_merged$REPORT)
cb_lics2_merged
```

```{r}
cb_lics2_merged |>
```

```{r}
dfcb.new<-dfcb[dfcb$YEAR>2019,]
sumcatch<-aggregate(dfcb.new$FV_WEIGHT,by=list(dfcb.new$YEAR,dfcb.new$LICENCE_ID),FUN="sum")
sumcatch$x<-round(sumcatch$x,0)
sumcatch.table<-reshape(sumcatch,direction="wide",idvar="Group.2",timevar="Group.1",v.names="x")
sumcatch.table<-sumcatch.table[,c(1,2,3,4,5,7,6,8)]
```
